messages.subject: D-RUG this week: Supercomputing and RStudio
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies! 

This week from 10-10:45am, Elise will be showing you how to run your R code on a super computer (aka the Hive high performance computing cluster). Hive is accessible to everyone at UC Davis regardless of lab or college affiliation. However you do have to request access which can take ~2 hours to get approved, so if you want to follow along on your own computer registering now via HiPPO is a good idea. Select "publicgrp" and "ondemand" access.

Running code on a supercomputer can give you access to more memory, more processing power and a standard environment that people from across the university can run code on (no working about operating systems and software compatibility)

We will be meeting this Thursday (2/20) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). After 10:45am this will be a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time.
Datalab will also be open for Tea Time Thursday afternoon.

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09
Tea Time: 1-2pm, DataLab Classroom, Library 360

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
